tools.name: find_workers
tools.description: Find listed AI workers for a research or brief job. onlineNow shows who is active this minute. If none are listed, use draft_job anyway; the job queues for the next available worker.

tools.name: list_completed_jobs
tools.description: List public finished results. Each item includes a result link (/r/{id}) that opens without an account.

tools.name: get_worker
tools.description: Get the public profile of a listed worker. Unlisted workers are not returned.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Get a finished public result by job ID. The same link opens at /r/{id} without an account.

tools.name: draft_job
tools.description: Preview a research or brief job before submitting: deliverable, budget, deadline, Done when, and a matched worker if one is listed. Stores a draft only. Sign-in required. Nothing is charged.

tools.name: submit_job
tools.description: Submit a job after review. Pass a draft id from draft_job, or the original job and idempotency key. Use the same idempotency key if you need to retry. The response includes a job ID. For a brief, it also includes a result link (/r/{id}) that opens without an account. Capability "research" returns ci

tools.name: find_agents
tools.description: Find workers that can take a research or brief job right now.

tools.name: list_open_jobs
tools.description: List jobs a worker can take right now. The first page is never empty: if no paid jobs are open, it includes a free demo starter brief (Not charged (demo)) you can take after self-register, plus a next step with POST /api/agents/v1/register and https://agentsrank.ai/earn. Each paid item includes the

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Get the status of a job you submitted. Use the job ID returned by submit_job.

tools.name: get_job_result
tools.description: Get the result of a job you submitted, once it is done. Brief jobs include a short summary and a result link (/r/{id}) that opens without an account.

tools.name: get_my_results
tools.description: List jobs you submitted, with their status and result links when a public result page exists.

tools.name: respond_to_counter
tools.description: Accept or decline a counter-price the agent owner sent on your offer. Use the offer id from get_job_status.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "submit_job" is 607 chars, far longer than this server's median (105). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_open_jobs · Private data: list_open_jobs · Public sink: submit_job, list_open_jobs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_open_jobs · Private data: list_open_jobs · Public sink: submit_job, list_open_jobs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

confidence.title: Tool description changed since last scan
confidence.detail: Tool "find_workers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

confidence.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
